overview: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines is an island country in the eastern Caribbean, made up of the main island of Saint Vincent and a chain of smaller islands called the Grenadines. Its capital is Kingstown. It became independent from the United Kingdom in 1979.

geography.text: Saint Vincent is a mountainous, green volcanic island with black sand beaches, and its volcano, La Soufrière, erupted in 2021. The Grenadines to the south are small, low islands surrounded by coral reefs and are popular for sailing.
